verdict.rationale: Snowflake publishes an official GitHub repo, snowflakedb/snowflake-rest-api-specs, containing OpenAPI-compliant specifications and importable Postman collections, and its REST API docs reference building integrations from those OpenAPI specs. The probe 404s at docs-domain openapi.json paths do not contradict this; they only show the spec is not served at conventional discovery URLs. Missing for 10: a spec discoverable at a well-known URL on the docs domain, explicit evidence that the SQL API and Cortex APIs are covered by downloadable specs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: These REST APIs are compliant with the OpenAPI specification.
Snowflake REST APIs enable developers and partners to use the language of their choice to build integrations with Snowflake using the openAPI specifications.
In Postman client, click Import, then choose import folder
